expected: Hero section stacked, hamburger menu, stats cards stacked

test_description: Homepage loads all asset bundles without errors
expected: All JS/CSS assets return 200, no failed network requests
actual: 35 network requests all returned 200. Assets include: index JS, vendor bundles (react, motion, redux, icons), CSS, fonts, page preloads (login, signup), API calls (users/me, notifications, system/home, assistant/session-messages), favicon, manifest
evidence: Network request log shows all 200 responses

actual: 1 CSP error (inline event handler blocked by script-src-attr 'none'), 1 CSP issue warning, 2 WebSocket warnings (closed before established — known issue from AGENTS.md #11)
evidence: Console messages: CSP inline handler error, WebSocket closed warnings
notes: CSP inline handler error is non-critical but should be addressed. WebSocket warning is a known issue per AGENTS.md #11.

expected: Page loads with buyer request list
actual: Page shows loading spinner (NeonAtom animation) but main content area remains empty during test window. Navigation timeout occurred on load (10s). Footer renders. Content may require longer load time or API may be slow.
evidence: Screenshot shows loading spinner only — no content rendered within test window
notes: Page loads but content rendering is slow. Navigation timeout (10s) exceeded. May need performance investigation.

expected: Clicking filter buttons (All/Buyer Requests/etc.) changes active filter
actual: Filter buttons visible and interactive — 'All' is active (highlighted), other buttons (Buyer Requests, Company Products, Posts, Unique OFF/ON) are clickable
evidence: A11y tree shows buttons with active states
notes: Filter buttons render and are interactive
